scope: Tracked paths plus non-ignored untracked source/doc/config files and the two generated map outputs; test trees over 200 files summarized by directory.
notes: Working-tree snapshot, not a clean-revision or live acceptance claim; concurrent lanes may change files after generation.
area is first matching architecture component; areas retains overlapping ownership. Non-owned paths get a descriptive area.
lane is exact lanes.owns glob matching; null means no explicit write owner. C bin exception is applied after A.
lastCommit is the last committed hash and subject touching the path, not a claim that current bytes are committed; null for untracked/generated files.
importsFrom/importedBy index resolved literal local ES imports, re-exports, dynamic imports and require calls, including tests before aggregation; not computed strings, HTML scripts or Java linking.

Routes include registrations and explicit HTTP dispatchers; duplicate public URLs retain their registering file. Legacy wildcard method dispatch is marked ANY; shared middleware may reject a request before dispatch.
Binary files have lines:0; source purposes reviewed against headers, declarations and exports.
Summary members retain every test path; all listed paths refer to repository files/directories.
